request.raw_text: Mirror the part according to the plane lying on the not rounded end of the part. Merge the mirrored part together with the existing one so they create one body.

areas_to_change.action: Mirror the complete existing part and merge the result with the original.
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: The plane coincident with the planar, non-rounded terminal end face of the long rectangular member.
areas_to_change.location: At the flat end opposite the currently rounded end.
areas_to_change.description: Create a reflected copy of the entire body across the flat terminal-end plane. The mirrored copy should extend outward from that end and be boolean-unioned with the original across their coincident end faces.

areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the original body in its current position and retain its complete geometry while adding the mirrored copy.
Preserve its existing curved profile; reproduce the same profile at the opposite outer end through mirroring.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Cylindrical hollow boss and rounded transition
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the boss diameter, bore, height, orientation, placement relative to the nearby rounded end, and its blended lower transition; reproduce them symmetrically in the mirrored half.
Preserve its cross-section, thickness, width, straight edges, and uninterrupted alignment through the mirror junction.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: A single elongated, mirror-symmetric solid consisting of the original body and a reflected copy joined at the original flat end. The completed member will have rounded outer ends and two symmetrically located hollow cylindrical bosses, one near each rounded end.
predicted_final_outcome.function: Produces a unified double-ended component with matching mounting or bearing bosses at opposite ends.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: The two halves will behave as one contiguous solid body with no assembly separation or internal interface at the mirror plane.

ambiguities.description: The request describes a plane lying on the non-rounded end but does not explicitly name a datum plane or end face.
candidate_interpretations: Use the plane coincident with the planar terminal end face of the rectangular member, which is the most likely intent.
Use a separate datum plane located at and parallel to that terminal end face, if such a datum already exists in the CAD model.
